inputs.text: The Senior Staff Association of Nigerian Universities has given the federal government a one-month ultimatum to wrap up the renegotiation of the 2009 agreement with the non-teaching university unions, or face an indefinite nationwide strike. This came from resolutions at their 54th National Executive Council meeting. These union threats are a clear attack on authority and social order, holding the education of our youth hostage and undermining the stability our families and nation depend on. Instead of showing personal responsibility and respect for established institutions, they're choosing disruption that weakens cultural continuity and national strength. The government must stand firm and prioritize order over caving to these tactics.
